en.description: Fabrication and sample preparation for advanced electronic and low-dimensional materials research.

zh.description: 針對先進電子與低維材料研究，進行材料製備與樣品前處理。

en.title: Variable-Temperature Optical Measurement
en.description: Photoluminescence (PL) with violet, green, and red excitation; Raman spectroscopy with green excitation; cathodoluminescence (CL); and photocurrent measurements.

zh.title: 變溫光學量測平台
zh.description: 提供紫光、綠光與紅光激發的光激發螢光（PL）、綠光激發拉曼（Raman）光譜、陰極螢光（CL）與光電流量測。

en.title: Variable-Temperature Magnetotransport
en.description: Four-point electrical measurements, Hall effect measurements, magnetoresistance, and angle-dependent spin transport.

zh.title: 變溫磁傳輸量測平台
zh.description: 提供四點電性量測、霍爾效應、磁阻與多角度自旋傳輸量測。

en.title: AI-Assisted Optical Measurement
en.description: Interferometric optical measurement integrated with AI-based data analysis and computation.
